fct_github_release_day.content:
name: fct_github_release_day
description: 'Metric 4 headline: PRs opened on release day against the Thursday before, one row per release day, with its breakdown. Population: One row for the configured release day (var github_release_day).'
model: ref('fct_github_release_day')
defaults:
  agg_time_dimension: release_day
entities:
  - name: release_day_key
    type: primary
    expr: release_day_key
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
dimensions:
  - name: release_day
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: GTA 6's release day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
measures:
  - name: activities_total
    agg: max
    expr: activities_total
    description: Activities in the breakdown.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: activities_available
    agg: max
    expr: activities_available
    description: Activities with a change.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: github_release_day_change
    agg: max
    expr: github_release_day_change
    description: PRs opened's release-day change, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: NULL until PRs opened has a change.
          additivity: non_additive
config:
  meta:
    dex:
      population:
        rule: One row for the configured release day (var github_release_day).
      assumptions:
        - decision: What the headline is
          chosen: PRs opened's release-day change (no longer the average of the three)
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user, 20 Nov: no average, just a headline; PRs opened is the biggest number, use that one'
          column: github_release_day_change
        - decision: Another activity not yet available
          chosen: headline still shown; the breakdown says which is missing
          evidence: request
          detail: the headline reads only PRs opened
          column: github_release_day_change
